policy: A branding-ready flag is not a release approval. A tenant may be indexed only after independent content, technical SEO, mobile, preview and production checks pass.

batch2.liveValidation: All four domains return 200 with independent canonical URLs, noindex/follow in both HTML and X-Robots-Tag, and an empty sitemap index.
batch2.nextGate: Complete independent content, mobile, structured-data and duplicate-content acceptance for each domain before promoting it to index/ready.

yda.liveValidation: Both apex and www hosts resolve through the dedicated YDA Worker. English home and five reviewed research pages per domain are indexable; canonical, robots, sitemap, favicon, WebSite JSON-LD, API data and desktop/mobile rendering passed.
